source_baseline.rule: Interaction decomposition never alters source-row identity. One source row may yield several interaction items, popup states and review pages; it never becomes several source rows.

worked_cases.PAPAN_TANDA: 1 source row → 4 interaction categories → 4 popup states
worked_cases.BBQ_PIT: 1 source row → 4 interaction categories → 4 popup states
worked_cases.KERUSI_TAMAN: 1 source row per material → 1 example detail screen → 2–4 specification interaction items → 2–4 popup states

identifier_spaces.source_row_uid: owned by the module source table; invariant at 26
identifier_spaces.interaction_item_id: owned by the execution family; one source row may yield several
identifier_spaces.runtime_state_id: a runtime state of a learner screen; a popup is a state, never a screen
identifier_spaces.review_page_role: a stable semantic role for the eventual PowerPoint review page
identifier_spaces.source_asset_id: owned by the extracted PDF asset register; invariant at 14

INTERACTION_SELECTION_DEPTH_MAX.meaning: the maximum number of learner selection levels inside a component interaction
INTERACTION_SELECTION_DEPTH_MAX.note: The component overview is an entry screen, not an interaction-selection level.

SCREEN_PATH_LAYER_COUNT_FROM_GROUP_MASTE.meaning: the number of screen layers traversed from the group master before reaching the deepest content state

invariants: A popup is a runtime state, never a learner navigation destination.
A popup must never open another popup.
The two metrics are recorded separately; no single ambiguous navigation_depth field exists.

FAMILY_S.name: STRUKTUR TAMAN
path: Kembali to Struktur Taman group master
rules: examples may be selected in any order
each viewed example receives a tick
popup closes using a close icon
popup is a state, not another navigation level
Kembali enables only after all examples are viewed
completed items remain reviewable
completed states persist on revisit and LMS resume
group completion controls the LMS shell Next
no duplicate learner-canvas Seterusnya button
FAMILY_S.interaction_instruction: Klik pada setiap contoh untuk penjelasan lanjut.
FAMILY_S.forbidden_instruction: Klik pada setiap item — must not be used where the item is specifically an example

FAMILY_P1.name: MULTI-EXAMPLE PERABOT
path: close icon returns to the example detail
Kembali returns to the component overview/list
rules: full-slide examples are Bariah Level 1
specification items are Bariah Level 2
the specification popup is a runtime state
one source row may produce several specification interaction items
interaction items remain traceable to the same source_row_uid
an example detail may carry one or more specification items
closing the popup returns to the same example detail
Kembali on the example detail returns to the component overview/list
completing all required examples completes the component
completion state persists on revisit and resume
forbidden: forcing the Family S pattern Contoh [Komponen] → row popup → Kembali to group master onto this family

FAMILY_P2.name: SPECIFICATION-DIRECT PERABOT
path: close icon returns to the specification list
rules: one source row may map to several interaction categories
each category retains its source locator
no new source rows are created
the close icon returns to the category list
no generic one-item completion path
category completion and component completion are explicitly modelled
completed categories remain reviewable
forbidden: any generic one-item Contoh screen for Papan Tanda or BBQ Pit
